Do I need to know Arabic?+

You can begin by exploring English meanings alongside Arabic words. SuraLink is designed to help you build understanding at your own pace.

Where can I download SuraLink?+

SuraLink is available on the Apple App Store. Open the listing on your iPhone to check compatibility and download the app.

Is the new design available yet?+

The preview on this page shows the next chapter we’re working on. The current App Store release may look different. The listing always has the latest released version.

How much does it cost?+

Please check the App Store listing and the in-app subscription screen for current pricing and available purchases. Any subscription terms are shown before you confirm a purchase.
